title: Book Three · Chapter 135: The Free Afternoon
story:
In the second week of term, a new notice goes up near the school library.

A local training centre is opening a room to visitors on Sunday. The visit is free. People can ask about lessons and try two short activities.

Ronan reads the notice after lunch. One activity is about clear notes. The other is about customers and their questions.

He copies the place and the time: two until four.

The centre is across town, near the last stop of a local bus. Ronan knows the bus from the market road. He asks at the stop on his way home.

One yuan there. One yuan back.

That evening, he takes his work envelope out. There are still twenty-three yuan inside.

He puts two beside it, then checks the Sunday time again. He can eat at home before he goes.

Mum is putting away a finished skirt.

“Sunday?” she asks.

“A room at the training centre. I want to see the customer activity.”

She reads the little copy of the notice.

“Take your questions.”

“I have quite a few.”

“A second bag, then.”

He smiles and puts his pencil in his own cloth bag. The two yuan stays separate for the bus.

On Friday, he tells Anna about the visit.

She is drawing two views of the same building. One shows the front. The other shows the rooms from above.

“You want to come?” he asks.

“I need Sunday for these. The teacher can look at them on Monday.”

He looks at the unfinished lines.

“Both views?”

“They need to agree. This wall keeps moving.”

She points to a line and rubs it out.

Ronan smiles. “A useful wall at home.”

“Not in a drawing.”

He sits beside her for a little while. She puts the wall back in the right place and checks the front view against it.

Ronan looks from one drawing to the other.

“Is that the same room?”

“Yes. Look at this corner.”

She points to the outside view first. Then she moves her finger to the plan from above.

Ronan follows slowly. He finds the window, but the door is on another side.

“I keep turning the room in my head.”

“Turn the paper first.”

Anna turns one sheet. For a moment, the two corners are beside each other. Ronan can see the wall she has changed.

“There.”

She smiles and turns the sheet back to its usual position.

The new view still takes him a moment to follow. He points to the window again and checks it against the first drawing.

Ronan takes his notebook from his bag. Anna gives him her pencil. He marks the place on a spare page of his own, then gives the pencil back.

“You have work for Sunday,” he says.

“So do you.”

They leave their two different plans beside the open notebooks.

“Tell me about the visit afterward,” she says.

“I will.”

At home on Sunday, Ronan eats lunch early. He puts the copied notice in his bag with a clean sheet for notes. He writes one question: What do the lessons include?

Dad comes in for water before he returns to work. Ronan shows him the two activity names.

“Both?” Dad asks.

“I want to try them.”

Dad nods and fills his cup. Ronan takes the two bus coins and leaves the other twenty-one in the envelope. Then he walks toward the market road with his bag over one shoulder.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

training centre＝培训中心；notice＝通知；view＝一个方向看到的样子、视图；agree＝相符、一致。

## 理解问题

1. 这个下午活动收费吗？Ronan准备从哪里拿多少车费？
2. Anna为什么不一起去？她在两张图之间核对什么？

## 读句子

**They need to agree.**

拆开看：They / need to agree.

这两张不同方向的图／需要彼此相符。
